envelope.reason: a refusal the README promises as one line is a stack trace
envelope.cause: smoke-running install from a directory with a scaffolded config

payload.title: install in a directory with an unresolvable cratylus.config.ts prints a stack trace
payload.body: Observed on unit/consumer-path b5735e03: in a directory holding the cratylus.config.ts that cratylus init writes, with cratylus and @cratylus/canon not installed there, cratylus install --all --dry-run ends in an uncaught MissingPackageError stack trace rather than a one-line 'cratylus install: <what>; <what to do>' refusal. install() loads a config in the cwd before anything else (a config wins over the bundled corpus). packages/cli/README.md tells the consumer to run install from a directory without a cratylus.config.ts.
